t: You're looking at the Hilton London Metropole, a big four-star hotel and conference centre with around eleven hundred rooms, on Edgware Road in Westminster. It sits between the Marylebone Flyover to the north and Praed Street to the south, with the Paddington Basin development just to the west. The name on the door is Hilton, and that goes back to Conrad Hilton, the American hotelier who founded the chain. He bought his first hotel in Texas in 1919 and went on to build the world's first international hotel chain.
